criteria: Engineering regressions; not clinical, laboratory or Android-device certification

results.name: Rail pairs straddling a former 10 ms block are detected at every recording origin and rate
Clipping evidence intervals remain identical across callback partitions
A clipped local interval does not discard the remaining phonetic recording
Sub-rail limiting remains an explicit warning and recording stays analyzable
Coverage counts omitted boundary frames in the original continuous denominator
A failed segment leaves valid later segment data and its original sample position intact
Coverage accounting uses exact sample counts at fractional-second segment boundaries
Cancellation propagates through segment isolation
Competing close roots get globally unique monotonic matches
Cross-model matching does not pair a narrow pole with a nearby very broad pole
Independent selection results depend on selected exact PCM, not surrounding DC or pitch
Very short selections remain browsable with empty quantitative tracks
Optional parameter sensitivity never upgrades a missing value and stores model residual evidence
Late independent selection analysis cannot overwrite a hidden page
Unknown source startup error offers a choice; a normal retry is still immediately usable
Re-recording during selection analysis cancels old work and clears the busy state
Explicit compatibility choice applies to the next session and preserves provenance
Permission and configuration errors do not invite an unrelated source retry
Localized synchronous unsupported-source errors fall back once and capability cache follows the SDK environment
Optional laboratory sweep records real points and detects compressed level response without compensation
Lab evidence appends to an old preset without changing dates, grade, validity or binding
Malformed historical laboratory metadata cannot prevent opening advanced calibration
